{{Quote|I've isolated an identifying element in the rakghouls' physiology, making it possible to detect and track their movements.|Vernan|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Vernan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] of [[xenobiology]] who researched [[rakghoul]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was one of the three leading rakghoul experts on Taris at that time. He had a camp in the [[Republic Resettlement Zone]], however in [[3643 BBY]] it got attacked by rakghouls and Vernan's colleague [[Soylon]] was killed. While conducting a message to his widow, Vernan was approached by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Voidhound]], was was arrange to take a package from him and deliver it to [[Beryl Thorne]]. Vernan had to send the smuggler on an errand Soylon left unfinished before conducting business. [[3642 BBY|Next year]], the Empire made a push to drive the Republic off Taris and ruin the restoration effort. During that time Vernan was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Imperial forces.
